```{r}
#| label: setup
# Everything on this page is read from data/processed/ only.
# Numbers are computed here from those CSVs, never typed in by hand.
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmltools)

PROCESSED <- file.path("..", "data", "processed")   # Quarto runs from dashboard/
read_processed <- function(file) read_csv(file.path(PROCESSED, file), show_col_types = FALSE)
metrics  <- read_processed("portfolio_metrics.csv")
summ     <- read_processed("sector_summary.csv")
holdings <- read_processed("bcred_holdings_clean.csv")

UNASSIGNED <- "Not assigned to an industry by BCRED"
TIER_ORDER <- c("High", "Medium", "Low", "No emissions proxy")
# One blue scale: darker = more emissions-intensive. Gray = no proxy.
TIER_COLORS <- c(High = "#104281", Medium = "#2a78d6", Low = "#86b6ef", "No emissions proxy" = "#c3c2b7")

latest   <- max(metrics$period)
m        <- metrics[metrics$period == latest, ]
s_latest <- summ[summ$period == latest, ]

fmt_bn  <- function(x) paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e9, format = "f", digits = 2), "bn")
fmt_pct <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d), "%")
fmt_date <- function(d) format(as.Date(d), "%b %d, %Y")

tier_share <- s_latest |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  summarise(fair_value = sum(fair_value), pct = sum(pct_of_portfolio), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(tier = factor(tier, levels = TIER_ORDER)) |>
  arrange(tier)
pct_low_medium <- sum(tier_share$pct[tier_share$tier %in% c("Low", "Medium")])
top_sector     <- s_latest |> filter(industry != UNASSIGNED) |> slice_max(fair_value, n = 1)
n_industries   <- sum(s_latest$industry != UNASSIGNED)

# A chart title that states the finding, placed above the chart.
chart_title <- function(text, sub = NULL) {
  tagList(tags$p(style = "font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 2px 0;", text),
          if (!is.null(sub)) tags$p(class = "proxy-label", style = "margin:0 0 6px 0;", sub))
}
```

# Overview

## Row {height=18%}

::: {.card}
::: {.takeaway}
**So what:** `r fmt_pct(pct_low_medium)` of BCRED's `r fmt_bn(m$total_fair_value)` portfolio sits in Low- or Medium-intensity sectors. `r top_sector$industry` alone is `r fmt_pct(top_sector$pct_of_portfolio)`. That puts its exposure-weighted sector emissions-intensity indicator at **`r round(m$indicator_t_per_usd_m)` t CO2e per $m**, with only `r fmt_pct(m$pct_fv_high_tier)` of fair value in High-intensity sectors.
:::
::: {.proxy-label}
Sector-level proxy, not financed emissions. Snapshot: `r m$form` for the period ended `r fmt_date(latest)`. Indicator covers `r fmt_pct(m$coverage_pct)` of fair value; the rest has no sector factor.
:::
:::

## Row {height=60%}

```{r}
#| label: tier-chart
tier_plot <- plot_ly(
  tier_share, x = ~pct, y = ~tier, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
  marker = list(color = unname(TIER_COLORS[as.character(tier_share$tier)])),
  text = ~fmt_pct(pct), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE,
  hovertext = ~paste0(tier, " tier<br>", fmt_bn(fair_value), " (", fmt_pct(pct), " of fair value)"),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Share of fair value (%)", range = c(0, max(tier_share$pct) * 1.15),
                 gridcolor = "#e1e0d9", zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed"),
    margin = list(l = 10, r = 30, t = 10, b = 40),
    plot_bgcolor = "#fcfcfb", paper_bgcolor = "#fcfcfb",
    font = list(family = "system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif")
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

tagList(
  chart_title(
    paste0("Most of the portfolio is in Low- and Medium-intensity sectors (",
           fmt_pct(pct_low_medium), "); High-intensity sectors are ", fmt_pct(m$pct_fv_high_tier)),
    paste0("Share of fair value by emissions-intensity tier, ", fmt_date(latest),
           ". Tiers are tertiles of the EPA sector factor across 54 mapped industries.")),
  tier_plot
)
```

# Sector heatmap {scrolling="true"}

```{r}
#| label: heatmap-prep
# Rows: industries held at the latest period, grouped by tier, largest first.
row_order <- s_latest |>
  mutate(tier = factor(tier, levels = TIER_ORDER)) |>
  arrange(tier, desc(fair_value)) |>
  mutate(row_label = paste0(industry, " · ", tier))

periods <- sort(unique(summ$period))
heat <- summ |>
  filter(industry %in% row_order$industry) |>
  left_join(select(row_order, industry, row_label), by = "industry")

z    <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(row_order), length(periods))
hover <- matrix("", nrow(row_order), length(periods))
for (k in seq_len(nrow(heat))) {
  i <- match(heat$industry[k], row_order$industry); j <- match(heat$period[k], periods)
  z[i, j] <- heat$pct_of_portfolio[k]
  hover[i, j] <- paste0(
    "<b>", heat$industry[k], "</b><br>", fmt_date(heat$period[k]), "<br>",
    fmt_pct(heat$pct_of_portfolio[k], 2), " of fair value (", fmt_bn(heat$fair_value[k]), ")<br>",
    "Tier: ", heat$tier[k],
    ifelse(is.na(heat$factor_t_per_usd_m[k]), "",
           paste0("<br>Factor: ", round(heat$factor_t_per_usd_m[k]), " t CO2e/$m")))
}

top_each_period <- summ |> filter(industry != UNASSIGNED) |> group_by(period) |>
  slice_max(fair_value, n = 1) |> ungroup()
top_name  <- names(sort(table(top_each_period$industry), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
top_count <- sum(top_each_period$industry == top_name)
max_high  <- max(metrics$pct_fv_high_tier)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
blue_scale <- list(c(0, "#cde2fb"), c(0.25, "#86b6ef"), c(0.5, "#3987e5"),
                   c(0.75, "#1c5cab"), c(1, "#0d366b"))
heat_plot <- plot_ly(
  x = format(periods, "%b %Y"), y = row_order$row_label, z = z,
  type = "heatmap", colorscale = blue_scale, zmin = 0, xgap = 2, ygap = 2,
  text = hover, hoverinfo = "text",
  colorbar = list(title = list(text = "% of fair value"), thickness = 12),
  height = 24 * nrow(row_order) + 140
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -45, side = "top"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed", tickfont = list(size = 11)),
    margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 60, b = 10),
    plot_bgcolor = "#fcfcfb", paper_bgcolor = "#fcfcfb",
    font = list(family = "system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif")
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

tagList(
  chart_title(
    paste0(top_name, " has been BCRED's largest sector in ", top_count, " of ", length(periods),
           " periods; High-intensity sectors never exceed ", fmt_pct(max_high), " of fair value"),
    paste0("Share of fair value by industry and quarter. Rows are the ", nrow(row_order),
           " industries held at ", fmt_date(latest), ", grouped by tier (label after the dot). ",
           "Blank cells: not held that period.")),
  heat_plot
)
```

## Row

```{r}
#| label: sector-table
tagList(
  chart_title(paste0("Sector detail, ", fmt_date(latest)),
              "Same numbers as data/processed/sector_summary.csv. Sector-level proxy, not financed emissions."),
  reactable(
    s_latest |>
      arrange(desc(fair_value)) |>
      transmute(Industry = industry, Tier = tier,
                `Fair value ($bn)` = fair_value / 1e9,
                `% of portfolio` = pct_of_portfolio,
                `Factor (t CO2e/$m)` = factor_t_per_usd_m,
                `% of indicator` = pct_of_indicator),
    searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 15, compact = TRUE, striped = FALSE,
    columns = list(
      `Fair value ($bn)`   = colDef(format = colFormat(digits = 2)),
      `% of portfolio`     = colDef(format = colFormat(digits = 2)),
      `Factor (t CO2e/$m)` = colDef(format = colFormat(digits = 0), na = "no proxy"),
      `% of indicator`     = colDef(format = colFormat(digits = 1), na = "–")
    )
  )
)
```

# Holdings explorer

```{r}
#| label: holdings-prep
band <- function(pct_cost, cost) dplyr::case_when(
  cost == 0          ~ "Cost is zero (e.g. warrants)",
  pct_cost < 80      ~ "Below 80% of cost",
  pct_cost < 100     ~ "80-100% of cost",
  TRUE               ~ "At or above cost"
)
h <- holdings |>
  transmute(
    Investment   = investment,
    Affiliation  = ifelse(is.na(affiliation), "BCRED JV stake (not stated)", affiliation),
    fair_value_m = fair_value / 1e6,
    cost_m       = cost / 1e6,
    pct_of_cost  = ifelse(cost > 0, 100 * fair_value / cost, NA_real_),
    Valuation    = band(pct_of_cost, cost),
    pct_nav      = 100 * pct_net_assets,
    rate         = 100 * interest_rate,
    spread       = 100 * spread
  )
n_below_80 <- sum(h$Valuation == "Below 80% of cost")
n_above_cap <- sum(h$pct_of_cost > 200, na.rm = TRUE)
shared <- SharedData$new(h, key = ~Investment, group = "holdings")
```

## {.sidebar}

**Filter holdings**

```{r}
filter_select("aff", "Affiliation", shared, ~Affiliation)
filter_select("val", "Valuation vs cost", shared, ~Valuation)
filter_slider("fv", "Fair value ($m)", shared, ~fair_value_m, round = TRUE)
```

Filters apply to both the chart and the table. Drag a box on the chart to select holdings.

Industry isn't shown: BCRED doesn't tag industry on individual holdings, only on sector subtotals.

```{r}
#| label: holdings-chart
scatter <- plot_ly(

  marker = list(color = "#2a78d6", size = 8, opacity = 0.55,

                 "<br>Fair value: $", formatC(fair_value_m, format = "f", digits = 1), "m",
                 "<br>Cost: $", formatC(cost_m, format = "f", digits = 1), "m",
                 "<br>Fair value / cost: ", formatC(pct_of_cost, format = "f", digits = 1), "%"),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Cost ($m, log scale)", type = "log", gridcolor = "#e1e0d9"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Fair value as % of cost", range = c(0, 200), gridcolor = "#e1e0d9"),
    shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 100, y1 = 100,
                       line = list(color = "#898781", width = 1, dash = "dot"))),
    margin = list(l = 50, r = 10, t = 10, b = 50),
    plot_bgcolor = "#fcfcfb", paper_bgcolor = "#fcfcfb", dragmode = "select",
    font = list(family = "system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif")
  ) |>
  highlight(on = "plotly_selected", off = "plotly_deselect", color = "#104281") |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

tagList(
  chart_title(
    paste0("Most holdings are valued close to cost; ", n_below_80, " of ",
           format(nrow(h), big.mark = ","), " are marked below 80% of cost"),
    paste0("Each dot is one holding (", fmt_date(latest), "). Dotted line = valued at cost. ",
           "Y-axis cut at 200% (", n_above_cap, " holdings above it); ",
           sum(h$Valuation == "Cost is zero (e.g. warrants)"), " zero-cost holdings not plotted.")),
  scatter
)
```
